_readme: Expected screen and Help content, organized by SCREEN -> LANGUAGE (EN / ES).
Keys that start with an underscore (_readme, _source, _todo, _note) are comments and are ignored by the framework.
content = the ordered list of text blocks (paragraphs, headings, options, buttons) exactly as they appear top-to-bottom.

Block fields: type (label for error messages), text (one line) OR lines (several lines separated by
), bold (whole block bold), boldText (only these fragments are bold; everything else must be non-bold), underlineText / italicText (optional), tag (optional HTML tag check, e.g. h1), style (optional computed CSS check, e.g. {"fontSize": "24px"}).
{CENSUS_DAY} is replaced with CENSUS_DAY from resources/environment/.env.uat before comparing.
Only LOGIN content is stored for reference; the current feature files validate CONFIRM landing content and the CONFIRM / VERIFY Help modals only.

content.text: Welcome to the 2026 Census Test

This 2026 Census Test questionnaire will be used to count people who, on April 1, 2026, were living or staying in certain types of group quarters, such as college residence halls, skilled-nursing facilities, assisted living facilities, group homes, halfway houses, residential treatment centers, military barracks, correctional facilities, workers' dormitories, and residential vocational training programs.
To complete your 2026 Census Test questionnaire, please enter the 12-digit Census ID provided in either the email or letter that you received.
Census ID (12-digit)
Log In
Your session will expire after 15 minutes of inactivity. If you leave the questionnaire and return later, you will have to start over.

Do not use the web browser buttons (back, forward) or close browser. Use the buttons within the questionnaire to navigate. For best results, use the latest version of Chrome, Firefox, Edge, or Safari. Enable cookies.
U.S. Census Bureau Notice and Consent Warning

You are accessing a United States Government computer network. Any information you enter into this system is confidential. It may be used by the Census Bureau for statistical purposes and to improve the website. If you want to know more about the use of this system, and how your privacy is protected, visit our online privacy webpage at https://www.census.gov/about/policies/privacy/privacy-policy.html.

Use of this system indicates your consent to collection, monitoring, recording, and use of the information that you provide for any lawful government purpose. So that our website remains safe and available for its intended use, network traffic is monitored to identify unauthorized attempts to access, upload, change information, or otherwise cause damage to the web service. Use of the government computer network for unauthorized purposes is a violation of Federal law and can be punished with fines or imprisonment (PUBLIC LAW 99-474).
